anchor.title: The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee
anchor.creator: State of Tennessee
anchor.caption: The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee (statehood 1796) — the emblem of the state government whose three branches this standard examines.
anchor.alt_en: The Great Seal of the State of Tennessee, reading Agriculture and Commerce, dated 1796.
anchor.alt_es: El Gran Sello del Estado de Tennessee, con las palabras Agricultura y Comercio y el año 1796.

anchor.title: Flag of Tennessee
anchor.creator: State of Tennessee (design 1905)
anchor.caption: The Tennessee state flag: its three stars stand for the three Grand Divisions — East, Middle, and West.
anchor.alt_en: The Tennessee state flag: red field, blue circle with three white stars, blue-and-white bar at the fly.
anchor.alt_es: La bandera del estado de Tennessee: campo rojo, círculo azul con tres estrellas blancas.
